# 11 with Jordan

## Jordan
- Onboarding **win**: the new checklist cut ramp-up time from three weeks to ten days.
- Workload: Jordan is stretched across two teams and the workload feels too heavy; Jordan would like to drop the analytics rotation. Me will talk to Sam about taking Jordan off it by the end of the month.

## Me
- Feedback: design reviews — share the doc a day ahead so people can read it; Jordan agreed.
- Remember: anniversary on 12 August.

## Topics Discussed
- Jordan's onboarding checklist results: ramp-up reduced from three weeks to ten days.
- Jordan's workload across two teams and request to drop the analytics rotation.
- Design review feedback on sharing docs a day ahead.
- June all-hands: Jordan to present onboarding results and send a draft by the 20th.

## Wins & Concerns
- Win: new onboarding checklist cut ramp-up time from three weeks to ten days.
- Concern: Jordan is stretched across two teams and wants to drop the analytics rotation.

## Feedback
- Me → Jordan: In design reviews, share the doc a day ahead so people can read it. Jordan agreed.

## Commitments
- Me — Talk to Sam about taking Jordan off the analytics rotation by the end of the month.
- Jordan — Share design review docs a day ahead.
- Jordan — Present onboarding results at the June all-hands and send Me a draft by the 20th.

## For Next Time
- Follow up on the analytics rotation after Me talks to Sam.
- Review Jordan's June all-hands draft by the 20th.
- Remember anniversary on 12 August.
